title: Monde
tagline: A World Mini App to farm the highest DeFi yields across chains
description:
This project combines data ingestion, smart contracts, and yield management to help users earn the best yields across multiple EVM chains (Optimism, Arbitrum, World, Ethereum, Base) and 3 major DeFi protocols (AAVE, Fluid, Morpho). 

The platform automatically finds the highest APY opportunities, handles cross-chain bridging via Circle's CCTP, and manages deposits/withdrawals through smart contracts - all while providing real-time yield data through our API. (only native APY are calculated, rewards are excluded)
how_its_made:
Backend: Node.js/TypeScript API server with Express, MongoDB for data persistence, and Viem for blockchain interactions

Smart Contracts: Solidity yield manager contracts deployed across multiple chains with Circle's CCTP integration for seamless cross-chain transfers

Frontend: Next.js with Worldcoin Mini App UI Kit for a smooth user experience

Data Layer: Real-time APY aggregation from AAVE, Fluid, and Morpho protocols with automated yield optimization
